features: Section version history: a History button on each section lists earlier saves and restores any of them
Hero editor: the Tablet and Mobile canvases now show the real hero, with drag handles on top
Hero Carousel slide buttons: font size, font family and width controls
Buttons can link straight to a product category or sub-type, and to a section on another page
Email branding: logo, header and page colours are editable in admin and shared by every email
bugfixes: Saving a section can no longer silently overwrite a newer save made in another tab or by another user
Publishing a page only changes its status and never alters section content
Hero size controls change the rendered size on Desktop, Tablet and Mobile independently
